contradicting_evidence: A constructive weekly outcome is plausible if positive cross-cap proxy returns persist and growing stablecoin supply becomes deployed demand.
A weaker weekly outcome is plausible if ETH-relative deterioration, negative ETH ETF flows and seller-leaning spot conditions persist.
The structural prior provides consolidation and retest scenarios, but cannot resolve these competing paths or establish their timing.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: The endpoint direction over seven days is unresolved. Selective participation could develop into a broader advance, or stabilization could fail into a retest. Current evidence does not establish which mechanism will dominate, nor the depth or timing of a pullback.
falsification_conditions: Repeated positive settled flows across BTC and ETH, deployed liquidity, sustained ETH/BTC improvement and pullback-resistant participation would supersede the no-edge assessment with an upside case.
Repeated negative flows combined with persistent price deterioration, shrinking breadth and worsening ETH-relative performance would supersede it with a downside case.
Top-100 strength alone would not establish transmission into the unavailable microcap universe.
missing_evidence: Several subsequent settled ETF sessions and evidence connecting liquidity growth to actual market demand.
A sustained daily price and ETH/BTC sequence, including behavior through pullbacks.
Updated macro trajectories, usable catalyst evidence and independently observed participation beyond the Top 100.
supporting_evidence: Backward-looking altseason measures differ substantially across windows: BlockchainCenter scores are 73 over 30d, 57 over 90d and 37 over 365d. Recent strength does not establish weekly continuation.
Stablecoin supply is growing, but deployment is NOT_ESTABLISHED; potential liquidity is not confirmed buying pressure.
The latest settled ETF session is split between positive BTC and negative ETH flows, and cannot establish a weekly flow trend.
Current proxy participation is positive, but canonical breadth is unconfirmed and below-Top-100 coverage is absent. Durable broad rotation remains unproven.
